morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动，-i 构成指向受惠者的动词；词根末尾 /t/ 在元音后缀前进入下一音节，读 di.rah.ma.ti。di- 不表示过去时。所给 Jawi 为词根 rahmat 的写法。

senses.zh_definition: 受到怜悯或慈爱，尤指蒙受真主的慈悯。
senses.en_definition: To be shown mercy or compassion, especially by Allah.
senses.ms_definition: Dikasihani atau dikasihi, khususnya oleh Allah.
senses.nuances: 为 merahmati 的被动形式，突出接受慈悯的人。常见于祈祷及宗教称呼；Semoga 表愿望，不能把 dirahmati 本身理解为“已经”。[PRPM：rahmat 与 merahmati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=rahmat)

collocations.en: may Allah have mercy on you or them

senses.zh_definition: 蒙受恩典或福泽，尤指得到真主的赐福。
senses.en_definition: To be blessed or granted divine favour.
senses.ms_definition: Diberkati atau dikurniai rahmat, khususnya oleh Allah.
senses.nuances: 与“受到慈悯”义密切相连，但侧重恩典和福泽。可用于仍然在世的人、家庭或生活，并非专指亡者。[PRPM：merahmati 的赐福义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=rahmat)

dual_scenarios.ms: Para hadirin yang dirahmati Allah, marilah kita memperkukuh semangat saling membantu dalam masyarakat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 蒙真主赐福的各位来宾，让我们加强社会中互相帮助的精神。
dual_scenarios.en: Distinguished guests, blessed by Allah, let us strengthen the spirit of mutual assistance in our community.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 穆斯林朋友之间表达祝愿
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah sampai rumah baru? Semoga kau sekeluarga sentiasa dirahmati Allah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah sampai di rumah baharu? Semoga kamu sekeluarga sentiasa dirahmati Allah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 到新家了吗？愿你们一家一直蒙真主赐福。
dual_scenarios.en: Have you arrived at your new home? May Allah always bless you and your family.

messages.ms_spoken: Dah, baru sampai tadi. Amin, terima kasih. Semoga kau pun dirahmati Allah.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, kami baru sahaja sampai. Amin, terima kasih. Semoga kamu juga dirahmati Allah.

messages.en: Yes, we just arrived. Amen, thank you. May Allah bless you too.

etymology.historical_story: Rahmat comes from Arabic raḥmah, meaning mercy or compassion. Malay uses this borrowed noun with its own verb morphology: merahmati means to show mercy or bestow blessings, while dirahmati presents the recipient as receiving them. The word connects a religious vocabulary of divine generosity with a productive Malay grammatical pattern. [PRPM dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=rahmat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rahmat＝慈悯与恩典；di- 提醒你看“接受者”：dirahmati Allah＝蒙真主慈悯或赐福。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 带明显的宗教敬意，常见于穆斯林祝祷、讲道和正式宗教称呼。使用时保持诚恳，不宜模仿讲道口吻取笑他人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可祝福在世者，也可为亡者祈求慈悯，应由上下文判断。面对宗教背景不明的对象，可采用 Semoga sentiasa sejahtera 等较中性的祝愿。
